sys_script_include.description: Renders a canonical aggregate (AggregateSerializer output) as ACORD-aligned XML: InsuredOrPrincipal, Producer, CommlPolicy, Location, CommlCoverage with Limit/Deductible and LimitAppliesToCd. Codes translate through value_map acord_* schemes; unknown codes are emitted as-is.
sys_script_include.name: AcordRenderer
